contract.task_clause:
An auditor decides to use the blank form of positive accounts receivable confirmation. The auditor should be aware that the blank form may be ineffective because
Option A: All accounts do not have an equal opportunity to be selected for confirmation.
Option B: Accounts unconfirmed may have already been written off as uncollectible.
Option C: Few responses may occur because more effort is required of recipients.
Option D: Accounts actually confirmed may not be representative of the population.
